--// RAINBOW HUB v3.6.0 — Stable + Spin //--
--// by dyfufyfutyr 👑 //--

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

--// Налаштування //--
local SPEED = 60
local SMOOTHNESS = 0.15
local JOYSTICK_RADIUS = 60
local FLY_MAX = 1000
local WALK_MAX = 1000
local AUTOR_NAME = "dyfufyfutyr"
local LOAD_DURATION = 3

--// ---------- РОЛІ ---------- //
local CREATOR_NAMES = { ["dyfufyfutyr"] = true }

local function getRole(plr)
    if CREATOR_NAMES[plr.Name] then
        return "CREATOR", "👑", Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
    end
    return "USER", "🎮", Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 220)
end

local myRole, myIcon, myColor = getRole(player)

--// Стан //--

local noclip = false
local infJump = false
local anchored = false

local guiVisible = true
local espEnabled = false
local tracerEnabled = false
local teamCheckEnabled = false
local ESP_MAX_DIST = 1200
local espConnections = {}
local velocity = Vector3.zero
local bodyVelocity, bodyGyro

--// FOV / FreeCam / Fullbright / Spin //
local defaultFOV = 70
local customFOV = 70
local fovOverride = false

local freeCamSpeed = 50

local fullbrightEnabled = false
local xrayEnabled = false

local spinEnabled = false
local spinSpeed = 10
local spinConn = nil

local defaultLighting = {
    Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
    OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
    Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
    ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
    FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
}

--// Free Cam Joysticks //
local fcMoveActive = false
local fcMoveInput = Vector2.zero
local fcMoveTouch = nil
local fcLookActive = false
local fcLookInput = Vector2.zero

--// Aimbot & Misc //
local soundEnabled = true
local aimbotEnabled = false
local aimbotMode = "Hold"
local aimbotFOV = 100
local aimbotSmoothness = 0.25
local aimbotTargetPart = "Head"
local aimbotKeybind = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2

local espColorMode = "Rainbow"

--// Джойстик FLY //
local joyActive = false
local joyInput = Vector2.zero

--// ---------- LOADING SCREEN ---------- //
local loadingGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
loadingGui.Name = "LoadingScreen_" .. tostring(math.random(1, 999999))
loadingGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

loadingGui.DisplayOrder = 999
loadingGui.Parent = (RunService:IsStudio() and player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")) or CoreGui

local loadingBg = Instance.new("Frame")
loadingBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)

loadingBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
loadingBg.Parent = loadingGui

local bgGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
bgGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(20, 15, 40)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(15, 20, 45)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(20, 10, 35)),
})
bgGradient.Rotation = 45
bgGradient.Parent = loadingBg

local mainLoaderFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainLoaderFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 200)
mainLoaderFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -100)
mainLoaderFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local loadingText = Instance.new("TextLabel")

loadingText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)

loadingText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
loadingText.TextSize = 32
loadingText.Parent = mainLoaderFrame

local loadingSub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
loadingSub.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
loadingSub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 40)
loadingSub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
loadingSub.Text = "Loading assets..."
loadingSub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 200)
loadingSub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
loadingSub.TextSize = 14
loadingSub.Parent = mainLoaderFrame

local progressFill = Instance.new("Frame")

progressFill.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0, 100)
progressFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 200)
progressFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
progressFill.Parent = mainLoaderFrame

Instance.new("UICorner", progressFill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local loadStartTime = tick()

task.spawn(function()
    local hue = 0
    while tick() - loadStartTime < LOAD_DURATION do
        task.wait(0.03)
        hue = (hue + 0.02) % 1
        loadingText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.8, 1)
        progressFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.8, 1)
        
        local progress = math.clamp((tick() - loadStartTime) / LOAD_DURATION, 0, 1)
        progressFill.Size = UDim2.new(progress * 300, 0, 0, 6)
        progressFill.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(300 * progress) / 2, 0, 100)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(LOAD_DURATION)
    TweenService:Create(mainLoaderFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(loadingText, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(loadingSub, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(progressFill, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    task.wait(0.6)
    loadingGui:Destroy()
end)

--// ---------- GUI ---------- //

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")

local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)

closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
closeBtn.Text = "✕"

closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

closeBtn.Parent = mainFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", closeBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local closeStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

local scrollFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
scrollFrame.Name = "Scroll"
scrollFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -50)
scrollFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 44)
scrollFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
scrollFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0

scrollFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)

scrollFrame.Parent = mainFrame

local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")

local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")

pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)
pad.Parent = scrollFrame

--// Звук //
local toggleSound = Instance.new("Sound")
toggleSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://6895079853"
toggleSound.Volume = 0.4
toggleSound.Parent = screenGui

local function playClick()
    if not soundEnabled then return end
    local s = toggleSound:Clone()
    s.Parent = screenGui
    s:Play()
    Debris:AddItem(s, 1)
end

--// ХЕЛПЕРИ ---------- //
local orderCounter = 0

local function makeToggleBtn(text, callback)
    orderCounter += 1
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 36)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = 14
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.LayoutOrder = orderCounter
    btn.Parent = scrollFrame
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.Thickness = 2
    s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
    s.Parent = btn

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        playClick()
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            callback(btn, s)
        end)
        if not ok then
            warn("[Rainbow Hub Error]: " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end)
    return btn, s
end

local function updateBtnVisual(btn, stroke, isOn)
    if isOn then
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150)
        stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120)
    else
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
        stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
    end
end

local function makeLabel(text, color)
    orderCounter += 1
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = text
    lbl.TextColor3 = color
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    lbl.TextSize = 13
    lbl.LayoutOrder = orderCounter
    lbl.Parent = scrollFrame
    return lbl
end

local function makePairBtn(labelText, labelColor, onMinus, onPlus)
    local lbl = makeLabel(labelText, labelColor)
    orderCounter += 1
    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 30)
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.LayoutOrder = orderCounter
    holder.Parent = scrollFrame

    local minusBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    minusBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 1, 0)
    minusBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    minusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 85)
    minusBtn.Text = "−"
    minusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    minusBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    minusBtn.TextSize = 18
    minusBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    minusBtn.Parent = holder
    Instance.new("UICorner", minusBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local plusBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    plusBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 1, 0)
    plusBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 0, 0)
    plusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 85)
    plusBtn.Text = "+"
    plusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    plusBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    plusBtn.TextSize = 18
    plusBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    plusBtn.Parent = holder
    Instance.new("UICorner", plusBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    minusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        playClick()
        pcall(function() onMinus(lbl) end)
    end)
    plusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        playClick()
        pcall(function() onPlus(lbl) end)
    end)
    return lbl
end

--// ---------- ФУНКЦІЇ ПОЛЬОТУ ---------- //
local function createBodyMovers()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() end
    if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() end
    bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bodyVelocity.Parent = hrp
    bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
    bodyGyro.P = 1000
    bodyGyro.D = 50
    bodyGyro.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
    bodyGyro.Parent = hrp
end

local function destroyBodyMovers()
    if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() bodyVelocity = nil end
    if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() bodyGyro = nil end
end

--// ---------- SPIN ---------- //
local function stopSpin()
    if spinConn then
        spinConn:Disconnect()
        spinConn = nil
    end
end

local function startSpin()
    stopSpin()
    spinConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not spinEnabled then return end
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(spinSpeed), 0)
    end)
end

local function toggleSpin(state)
    spinEnabled = state
    if state then startSpin() else stopSpin() end
end

--// ---------- FULLBRIGHT & XRAY ---------- //
local function toggleFullbright(state)
    fullbrightEnabled = state
    if state then
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        Lighting.Brightness = 3
        Lighting.ClockTime = 12
        Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
    else
        Lighting.Ambient = defaultLighting.Ambient
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = defaultLighting.OutdoorAmbient
        Lighting.Brightness = defaultLighting.Brightness
        Lighting.ClockTime = defaultLighting.ClockTime
        Lighting.FogEnd = defaultLighting.FogEnd
    end
end

local function toggleXray(state)
    xrayEnabled = state
    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not obj:IsDescendantOf(player.Character or workspace) then
            if state then
                if obj.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and obj.Name ~= "Head" and obj.Transparency < 1 then
                    obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0.7
                end
            else
                obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
            end
        end
    end
end

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
    if xrayEnabled and obj:IsA("BasePart") then
        if obj.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and obj.Name ~= "Head" then
            obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0.7
        end
    end
end)

--// ---------- CAMERA FOV ---------- //
local function applyFOV()
    if fovOverride then camera.FieldOfView = customFOV else camera.FieldOfView = defaultFOV end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.5) do
        if fovOverride and math.abs(camera.FieldOfView - customFOV) > 1 then
            camera.FieldOfView = customFOV
        end
    end
end)

--// ---------- FREE CAM ---------- //
local function stopFreeCam()
    if freeCamConnection then
        freeCamConnection:Disconnect()
        freeCamConnection = nil
    end
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    if player.Character then
        camera.CameraSubject = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end
end

local function startFreeCam()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    stopFreeCam()
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    local camPos = camera.CFrame.Position
    local camYaw, camPitch = 0, 0
    
    freeCamConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not freeCamEnabled then return end
        if UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
            local delta = UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()
            camYaw = camYaw - delta.X * 0.003
            camPitch = math.clamp(camPitch - delta.Y * 0.003, -math.rad(89), math.rad(89))
        end
        if fcLookActive and fcLookInput.Magnitude > 0.05 then
            camYaw = camYaw - fcLookInput.X * 0.05
            camPitch = math.clamp(camPitch - fcLookInput.Y * 0.05, -math.rad(89), math.rad(89))
        end
        local rotation = CFrame.Angles(0, camYaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(camPitch, 0, 0)
        local moveDir = Vector3.zero
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDir += rotation.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDir -= rotation.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDir -= rotation.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDir += rotation.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveDir += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then moveDir -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if fcMoveActive and fcMoveInput.Magnitude > 0.05 then
            moveDir += rotation.LookVector * (-fcMoveInput.Y)
            moveDir += rotation.RightVector * fcMoveInput.X
        end
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then moveDir = moveDir.Unit end
        camPos = camPos + moveDir * freeCamSpeed * (1 / 60)
        camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(camPos) * rotation
    end)
end

--// ---------- ESP ---------- //
local function isEnemy(plr)
    if not teamCheckEnabled then return true end
    if not plr.Team then return true end
    if not player.Team then return true end
    return plr.Team ~= player.Team
end

local function teleportToPlayer(target)
    if not target or target == player or not target.Parent then return end
    local myHrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetHrp = target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHrp or not targetHrp then return end
    myHrp.CFrame = targetHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    if flying then velocity = Vector3.zero; if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero end end
end

    if target == player or espConnections[target] or not isEnemy(target) then return end
    local char = target.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp then return end

    highlight.Adornee = char

    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    highlight.Parent = char

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Name = "ESPTag_" .. target.Name
    billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 70)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.Adornee = hrp
    billboard.Parent = char

    local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    nameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    nameLabel.TextSize = 14
    nameLabel.Parent = billboard

    local hpBg = Instance.new("Frame")

    hpBg.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0, 22)
    hpBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)

    hpFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    hpFill.Parent = hpBg
    Instance.new("UICorner", hpFill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

    local distLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    distLabel.Text = ""

    distLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    distLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    distLabel.TextSize = 12
    distLabel.Parent = billboard

    local tpBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    tpBtn.Name = "TPBtn_" .. target.Name
    tpBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 28)
    tpBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    tpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 200)
    tpBtn.Text = "🚀 TP → " .. string.sub(target.Name, 1, 8)
    tpBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    tpBtn.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    tpBtn.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    tpBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    tpBtn.TextSize = 13
    tpBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    tpBtn.Active = true

    tpBtn.ZIndex = 100

    tpBtn.Parent = screenGui
    Instance.new("UICorner", tpBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local tpStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    tpStroke.Thickness = 2
    tpStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 150)
    tpStroke.Parent = tpBtn

    tpBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 230) end)

            if billboard and billboard.Parent and billboard.Enabled ~= inRange then billboard.Enabled = inRange end
            if highlight and highlight.Parent and highlight.Enabled ~= inRange then highlight.Enabled = inRange end
            if not inRange then
                if tpBtn and tpBtn.Parent and tpBtn.Visible then tpBtn.Visible = false end
                if tracer and tracer.Parent and tracer.Visible then tracer.Visible = false end
                return
            end
            local headPos = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
            local screenPos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(headPos)
            if onScreen then

                local startPos = Vector2.new(screenSize.X / 2, screenSize.Y)
                local endPos = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
                local delta = endPos - startPos

                    tracer.Size = UDim2.new(0, distance, 0, 1.5)

                    tracer.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
                end
            else

            end
        end)

local function getClosestTargetToCursor()
    local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local closest = nil
    local closestDist = aimbotFOV
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= player and isEnemy(plr) then
            local char = plr.Character
            if char then
                local part = char:FindFirstChild(aimbotTargetPart) or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if part and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    local screenPos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                    if onScreen then
                        local dist = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - mousePos).Magnitude
                        if dist < closestDist then closestDist = dist; closest = part end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not flying then return end
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp or not bodyVelocity or not bodyGyro then return end
    local moveDir = Vector3.zero
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDir += camera.CFrame.LookVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDir -= camera.CFrame.LookVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDir -= camera.CFrame.RightVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDir += camera.CFrame.RightVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveDir += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then moveDir -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    if joyActive and joyInput.Magnitude > 0.05 then moveDir += camera.CFrame.LookVector * (-joyInput.Y); moveDir += camera.CFrame.RightVector * joyInput.X end
    if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then moveDir = moveDir.Unit end
    local targetVelocity = moveDir * SPEED
    velocity = velocity:Lerp(targetVelocity, SMOOTHNESS)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = velocity
    bodyGyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + camera.CFrame.LookVector)
end)
